summary: 2D text rendering bounded by a scissor rectangle. Computes the text size via sub_5531F0, scales it by the layout divisors at a4+92 and a4+96 with CRTFtol, and only renders when both scaled dimensions are positive. It then computes an anchored text region from the layout centers this+0x8/this+0xC, runs a six-call FloatToIntConversionChain batch (five against the constant -2002081110, one against -1999844148) over the shrinking layout array, and, when the UI flag dword_7CE23C[0] is set, draws a background widget through PositionComputationWithAlignment, TwoFieldSetterUpdate, FieldSetterCall_cf20 and ConditionalCall. Text is emitted via sub_553070 with a render-device global dword_8B8DC8 between FieldSetterAt0x48 save/restore of a4+72. When a6 and dword_7CE240 are set, a second widget draws a time-varied highlight color from RandomColorGenerator. Finally the caller-relative width cursor *a3 is advanced by the scaled height plus 8, which is also returned.

local_names.this: layout state carrying the X center (this+0x8) and Y offset (this+0xC)
local_names.a2: text handle/string object queried for its dimensions
local_names.a3: pointer to a caller-relative cursor (X position), advanced by the block height
local_names.a4: layout/theme descriptor holding divisors at +92/+96 and the field at +72
local_names.a6: flag enabling the time-varied color highlight widget
local_names.v17: anchor X minus half the scaled width
local_names.v19: saved layout field (a4+72) restored after text render

operations.description: sub_5531F0 queried for the text dimensions (width and height) of a2
Scales the reported dimensions: v8 = CRTFtol(v16 * *(a4+92)) and v9 = CRTFtol(v15 * *(a4+96))
Rendering block is entered only when both scaled dimensions are positive
Computes the anchored text region: anchor X from this+0x8 minus half the scaled width, offset Y from this+0xC minus the cursor *a3, and fills the float layout scratch array
Six-call FloatToIntConversionChain batch over the shrinking layout array: five calls against -2002081110 and a final call against -1999844148
Background widget drawn only when the UI flag dword_7CE23C[0] is set
Background widget emitted: PositionComputationWithAlignment at the anchor, TwoFieldSetterUpdate with the scaled size, FieldSetterCall_cf20 with 1728053247, and ConditionalCall with 0
Reverses the scale for placement: v13 from v17 divided by *(a4+92) and the cursor from *a3 divided by *(a4+96), both via CRTFtol; saves v19 = *(a4+72)
Text rendered by sub_553070 with the recomputed position and the render-device global dword_8B8DC8, bracketed by FieldSetterAt0x48(-1) before and FieldSetterAt0x48(v19) restore after
Highlight widget drawn only when both a6 and dword_7CE240 are set
Highlight widget emitted with a time-varied color from RandomColorGenerator(0xFFFFFF, -1, 0.0): PositionComputationWithAlignment, TwoFieldSetterUpdate, FieldSetterCall_cf20 and ConditionalCall
Advances the cursor *a3 by the scaled height plus 8 and returns that same value
Invoked by the UI render driver sub_49F870
